title: Phuket Town or Patong: Where Should You Stay?
excerpt: Compare a city stay with a beach-area base, plan transport and decide whether a split stay fits your Phuket itinerary.
content:
Choose Phuket Town if your trip revolves around heritage streets, city dining and plans in town. Choose Patong if having a beach at the centre of most days matters more. Neither base automatically gives you both experiences on your doorstep, so the useful question is: where do you want to spend your time, and how often will you travel across the island?

This guide compares the two choices and helps you build a realistic stay plan. Royal Phuket City Hotel is a city base on Phang-Nga Road; it suits the Phuket Town side of that decision.

What is the difference between Phuket Town and Patong?

Phuket Town offers an urban setting with the Old Town heritage district. Patong is a beach destination with accommodation, restaurants and visitor services around its bay. The Tourism Authority of Thailand describes the Old Town's historic buildings and cafe culture alongside Patong's beach and facilities in its official Phuket destination guide.

Your priorityConsider Phuket TownConsider Patong
The centre of your dayCity streets, heritage stops and diningThe beach and plans around the bay
A beach-led holidayPlan transport for beach outingsCheck the hotel's actual beach access
Meetings or events in townChoose accommodation around the venueAllow for the journey to and from town
A mixed itineraryGroup coastal activities into planned outingsGroup Old Town activities into a city visit

A hotel address matters as much as the area name. “Patong” does not guarantee a beachfront room, and “Phuket Town” does not mean every attraction is beside your entrance. Check the exact location and the route to the places you intend to visit.

When does a Phuket Town hotel make sense?

A city base is a practical choice when you want several town-based plans rather than one short sightseeing stop. You might enjoy an unhurried morning looking at architecture, time for a cafe break and an evening meal without arranging every day around a beach. Start with our Old Town activity guide, then choose the stops that interest you rather than trying to visit everything.

Town can also suit a trip built around a wedding, meeting or family occasion in the city. Confirm the event location first. A familiar meeting point near your accommodation can simplify the plan, but it does not remove the need to check the journey, especially for guests arriving at different times.

If this describes your trip, explore our Phuket Old Town hotel information. Treat the location as a starting point for your itinerary, rather than a promise that every destination is walkable.

When is Patong a better match?

Choose Patong when your main wish is to return to the beach area each day. For example, a traveller who wants a coastal morning, lunch nearby and another visit to the shore may prefer a beach-area base over repeated journeys from town.

Before booking, check where the property sits relative to the beach, whether reaching it involves a road crossing, and which room type you are choosing. If a sea view or direct beach access is essential, look for explicit confirmation rather than relying on a destination label or a photograph of the coastline.

You can still plan a visit to Phuket Town. Make it a deliberate part of the itinerary with time to explore, rather than assuming the city and beach form one small neighbourhood.

How should you plan journeys between the two areas?

Build the plan around your actual start and finish points. Ask about transport for your intended date and departure time, and keep room for traffic and changes in weather. A single online estimate is useful for orientation, but it should not become a tight deadline for an important event.

  • Check the pickup address, vehicle size and luggage arrangements.
  • Confirm whether the quoted journey includes the return or only one direction.
  • For an evening outing, arrange how you will return before leaving.
  • For a meeting or wedding, work backwards from the required arrival time.

At Royal Phuket City, you can contact the hotel with your travel dates and route questions. Request current details; do not assume a transfer is included in a room rate.

Is splitting your stay between town and beach worth it?

A split stay can help when both experiences are central to a longer trip. Consider a city portion for heritage and dining, followed by a coastal portion for beach-focused days. The tradeoff is another packing session, a transfer and two sets of check-in arrangements.

For a short stay, those practical costs may outweigh the benefit. Write down your must-do activities, group them by location and compare the number of journeys from one base with the effort of moving hotels. There is no universal minimum number of nights: the right choice depends on your pace, party and priorities.

What should you confirm before booking Royal Phuket City?

Royal Phuket City Hotel is at 154 Phang-Nga Road in Phuket Town. The hotel's room and suite pages show the available accommodation choices. Use those pages to narrow your options, then confirm the requirements of your own party.

  1. Room suitability: give the number of adults and children and ask about bed arrangements.
  2. Rate details: check the inclusions, payment terms and cancellation conditions of the rate you intend to book.
  3. Arrival: explain your expected arrival and ask about any special arrangements you need.
  4. Plans in town: check the location of your key activities and leave flexibility between them.
  5. Dining: review the hotel's dining options and enquire about reservations for your dates.

Quick answers for choosing your base

Is Royal Phuket City a beachfront hotel?

No. It is a city hotel in Phuket Town. Plan a separate journey when you want a beach outing.

Can I visit both Phuket Town and Patong from one hotel?

Yes, you can plan outings to both. Choose a base around the place you expect to use most often, then arrange transport for the other.

Which area is better for a first visit?

Start with your priorities. A heritage and city-dining itinerary points towards Town; a beach-led itinerary points towards Patong. If you are still deciding, compare your daily plans before comparing hotel rates.
